crossRefs.note: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that…
We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies…

translations.web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
translations.bsb: There is profit in all labor, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
translations.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
translations.asv: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
